verdict.rationale: PostHog documents an official CLI (`posthog-cli`) built for terminals, coding agents, scripts, and CI/CD. It offers API and MCP tool-catalog access, SQL queries, source-map upload, schema and task management, and headless environment-variable auth for agents. Its installer adds instructions to your coding agent, and the agentic `@posthog/wizard` CLI complements it. missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the CLI in agent workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The PostHog CLI lets you use PostHog from your terminal, your coding agents, local scripts, and CI/CD pipelines.
Use `posthog-cli api` to access PostHog's API and MCP tool catalog from shell-friendly commands, including running SQL queries against your data
For CI/CD, headless environments, or agents running without a browser, set environment variables instead
The PostHog wizard is an agentic CLI tool that uses AI to set up and manage PostHog in your codebase.
